declarations.rationale: Complete street/neighborhood/city address paths and geographic writer/office associations define neighborhood containment; messages and managerial roles separate.
Company/conglomerate/product national modifiers dominate.
Possessive lawyer appositions and legal-representation paths dominate; wife paths separate.
National leader and completed leadership-succession family defines inverse political leadership; ally-in and company based-in separate.
Die-at8 dominates death location; renomination and executive titles separate.
Write-in/review-in publication paths define author-publication family; legal representative and national-company examples separate.
Critic-for publication and authored reviews define writing for a publication.
Explicit member-of and institutional service/resignation/seat dominate membership; local office implies group participation.
Senate leader appositions and attributed leader statements dominate; vacated seat and sport coach separate.
Direct leader/leadership family identifies head office amid inverse ministers and sport coaching.
Explicit spokeswoman/spokesman role family dominates; datelines and emigration remain distinct.
Trail7 dominates competitive deficit, with overtaking at other times separate.
Company/auction-house premises and geographic room/house descriptors dominate.
Explicit managerial tenure and dismissal define sports manager role among team actions.
National company modifiers define affiliation, separate from geographic person descriptor.
In-country/region population and fleeing-location family defines physical presence; political attack or spokesperson office alone not presence.
Reporter-for and coverage-for plus publication descriptions define authorship affiliation; theatrical roles separate.
Genuinely mixed dean/director titles dominate over teaching and specialist roles.
Named directorship/tenure and appointment paths define exact office family, separate from aliases and geographic movement.
Director4 is largest specific title family, separate from head, spokesman and ideology.
Loss-in, winner-at and sporting final/championship context define event participation, without requiring victory.
Loss/gain-on/suffer-at-hands family establishes competitive interaction rather than a guaranteed win; coach role separate.
Institution premises, building and headquarters-at address family dominates.
Sovereignty/control/takeover family defines political territorial control, separate from person arrival/departure.
